## v0.5.51 · Shared storage and optional index recall / 共享存储与可选索引召回

### English

- Share Project Documents and Memory Spaces across workspaces independently. Each component follows the current storage scope by default. Switching scopes leaves existing data in its original directory. (#708)
- Enable **Index push (experimental)** to append bounded BM25 matches from active Project Documents and Memory Spaces to the current turn. It is off by default. (#707)
- Fix the Runtime Memory status when USER.md is shared, and prevent an error in an idle review check from interrupting the DSH Host. (#705, #706)

### 简体中文

- 项目档案和记忆空间可以分别设为全局共享，默认跟随当前存储范围。切换后，已有数据保留在原目录。（#708）
- 可开启实验性索引推送，用 BM25 从当前启用的项目档案和记忆空间中选取少量匹配条目，追加到本轮上下文。默认关闭。（#707）
- 修复全局共享 USER.md 时运行时记忆状态误报，以及空闲复盘检查出错时可能中断 DSH Host 的问题。（#705、#706）

Update from **Memory System → Status → Versions → Update**, then fully restart DSH. / 在**记忆系统 → 状态 → 检查版本 → 更新**中升级，然后完整重启 DSH。
